statement: In a category with finite products and equalizers, a pullback of $f : X \to Z$ and $g : Y \to Z$ exists and is a limit of the diagram $X \to Z \leftarrow Y$.
proof: Form the product $X \times Y$ with projections, then equalize the two composites $X \times Y \rightrightarrows Z$. The universal property of the equalizer yields the pullback cone.
